objective.value: Generate, store, and study personalized flashcard collections using an LLM, with authenticated users and persisted collections.

repositoryNote.value: Public repository README (FlashMaster) documents Next.js app with Clerk auth, Firebase storage, Meta-Llama/llama-3.1-8b generation, Stripe subscriptions, and Material UI.

problem.value: Learners need topic flashcards generated quickly, stored by user, and studied as collections — not a one-off prompt with no persistence.

overview.value: AI-assisted learning tool: users authenticate, generate flashcards from input via Llama APIs, and save titled collections (10 cards per topic) in Firebase. Identity-confirmed stack centers on Llama APIs and Firebase; repository README also documents Next.js, Clerk, Stripe, and Material UI.

architecture.value: Next.js application for frontend and backend routes; Clerk for sign-in/sign-up; Firebase for flashcard persistence keyed to user; Meta-Llama/llama-3.1-8b for generation; Stripe for Basic/Pro subscription packages (per repository README).

decisions.value: Persist generated cards in Firebase keyed to the authenticated user, and gate premium access through Stripe subscription packages rather than leaving generation as an unauthenticated one-shot.

constraints.value: Requires environment keys for Stripe, Llama API, and Clerk (per repository README). Collections are structured as 10 flashcards per topic title.
